andBeyond Ngorongoro Crater Lodge sits perched on the edge of the three million-year-old Ngorongoro caldera, with 30 roomy plush suites decorated in a Victorian, sumptuous style. This is a place where you are truly pampered from finish to end, with both suites for couples and coupled suites for families.
Dinners are lovely with chefs producing delectable entrees using fresh organic produce provided by local farmers. Here you feast in the lodge’s restaurant, or comfortable on your own terrace, where you look out over the Ngorongoro crater. As the sun sets, you can choose to summon a personal butler to bring you steaming hot tea in bed, create a flickering blaze in your fireplace, or draw you a soothing bath in a grand stand-alone tub. But you can also indulge in wine tasting within the lodge’s wine store and cap your evening with an in-room massage. And if you are lucky, you might hear the mighty Maasai warrior’s harmonious chant, as they pass by somewhere close along the vast crater.
blocks.html:
Perched on the rim of the three million-year-old Ngorongoro caldera, andBeyond Ngorongoro Crater Lodge has 30 spacious, plush suites furnished in a lavish Victorian style. From start to finish you are thoroughly pampered here, and there are suites for couples as well as connected suites for families.
Dinner is a treat, as the chefs create delicious entrees from fresh organic produce supplied by local farmers. You can dine in the lodge’s restaurant, or relax on your own terrace with a view over the Ngorongoro crater. When the sun goes down, you can call a personal butler to bring steaming hot tea to your bed, light a crackling fire in your fireplace, or run a soothing bath in a large free-standing tub. You can also enjoy a wine tasting in the lodge’s wine store and finish the evening with a massage in your room. With some luck you may even hear the harmonious chant of the Maasai warriors as they walk past somewhere nearby along the vast crater.
